scope: One exact local entropy-work accounting primitive within each admitted baseline coefficient block. Two native-input decode screens and one affected owned-input screen, same frozen inputs from one original 513x259 RGBA8 raster. No new image, size or quality enumeration.
changedPrimitive: After the original 64-unit block admission, noncancelable readers snapshot remaining context work. ReadBits and Huffman TryWork retain each original exact charge locally; finally publishes successful charges on every exit before further parent work. Tight-budget scalar fallback, original cursor/error precedence/predictor/partial writes, cancellation and progressive paths retained. Two stack longs; no new heap allocation/cache/table, dependency or native/unsafe code.

nativeBaseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

attribution.scope: One current retained native-input JPEG Decode8 warm CPU profile; workload loops include warmup/calibration. Not parity timing.
attribution.attributionRule: Exact method names before parentheses exclude parameter types. Inclusive methods overlap and cannot be added. The last visible frame may include inlined work or unattributed native transitions; it is not a pure managed-only cost.

allocationControls.boundary: Complete public Stream decode with fresh read-only caller stream and owned output disposal. Reflection argument storage is reused equally. Allocation controls only; the parity benchmark uses resident span input.

limitations: Three-sample native screens and one owned affected screen are not uniform <=2x certification. All statistical prechecks pass; postquiet failures and cooldowns are preserved.
The current CPU profile includes workload warmup/calibration; inclusive methods overlap and cannot be added. It supplies attribution, not parity timing.
Owned historical baseline precedes Work inlining; do not attribute its entire reduction to this block-local change.
Fixed-count Stream allocation controls compare actual packages, with caller streams and reflection storage used equally. They make no timing or span-allocation-specific claim.
PNG gaps, historical VP8L results, unmatched VP8 and unknown/material required paths remain open.
